articles.title: To the Red Dot Newsroom
General press information on the Red Dot Design Award
RESONANCE - Tallinn Architecture Biennale Installation / Aru Ma- Architects
articles.summary: Set against Tallinn's rapidly commercializing urban backdrop, the installation offers a sheltered courtyard detached from its surroundings, creating a deliberate pause. Here, the sea breeze whispers against silent stones, and sunlight filters onto the warm, sweeping curves of plywood screens. It is a spatial privilege carved from ordinary materials, filtering out external chaos for pure atmospheric luxury.

articles.title: Mahachai Residence / Patara Architects
articles.summary: Mahachai Residence occupies a riverside plot on the Tha Chin River, on land once occupied by the owner's boat-repair warehouse. Rather than erase this history, the house is conceived as a day-use villa, a place for the owner to rest, take in the river, and watch it turn gold at sunset, quietly carrying the memory of the site's working past into its structure and materials.

articles.title: Prukpirom House Renovation (PPR House) / S+S Architects
articles.summary: Prukpirom House Renovation transforms a family home that has stood for more than 29 years. Located on a generous site surrounded by mature greenery, the existing house offered opportunities to expand and reorganize the living spaces while retaining its relationship with the garden.

articles.title: La Negrita House / Estudio Palacios
articles.summary: Situated on the shores of Los Molinos Lake and surrounded by a dense eucalyptus forest, La Negrita embodies the desire for a peaceful retreat amid a beautiful, playful atmosphere with its own unique microclimate.

articles.title: Haras House / Felipe Hess Arquitetos
articles.summary: The Haras House is a single-story residence built on a trapezoidal lot. The "C" shaped volume organizes the spaces around a central courtyard, which features a garden, a porch, and a 25-meter lane, integrated into the resident's daily routine. The design prioritizes privacy and the direct relationship between internal and external spaces.

articles.title: CASA MG / Startup Architettura
articles.summary: Located within a 1930s residential building, Casa MG reinterprets and elevates some of the period's most distinctive and iconic architectural features, making them a recurring design language at the heart of the apartment's spatial reorganization.
